headline: 玩具总动员5领跑今日热搜
summary: 今日无新片上映，本周仅3部新片。热搜由《玩具总动员5》《绿灯军团》《蜘蛛侠：崭新之日》等领跑，超英与续集IP持续主导观众关注。
summaryEn: No movies released today, only 3 new films this week. Toy Story 5, Green Lantern Corps, and Spider-Man: Brand New Day lead trending, with sequels and superhero IPs dominating attention.
